title: Personal Application Roadmap
creator: Beth Kullberg
subject: College Admissions
description: Build a complete, college-specific application roadmap with 19 stops, from list-building to fall move-in. Each stop links to the chapter that explains it, holds that college's specifics and deadline, and has a checkbox for verifying it on the college's own website.

learningObjectives: Students will construct a complete application roadmap for one college on their list, filling in that college's specific policies, codes, and deadlines for every stage from list-building to move-in, and verifying each against the college's own website.
educational.duration: 15 minutes in class, then ongoing through senior year

controls: College name input and Starting from select
Load Iowa (Casey), Blank roadmap, and Print / save as PDF buttons
Per-stop specifics input, date input, Verified checkbox, and chapter link
Earlier stops and Later stops paging buttons; clickable road stops

keyQuestions: Which stops on your roadmap have hard deadlines, and which are ongoing?
Why does every stop need to be verified on the college's own website rather than a third-party site?
How would your roadmap change if you were starting in the fall of senior year instead of junior spring?
commonMisconceptions: Every college follows the same timeline, so one generic roadmap works for all of them.
Dates from last year's website or a ranking site are good enough without checking.
assessmentOpportunities: Students submit a printed roadmap for one college with all 19 stops filled, every date verified, and at least one catch-up decision explained.
